senses.gloss: m. du. (b. h.; שָׁפַת, cmp. אַשְׁפֹּת) border-mounds (between which is the balk).
units: <cite ref="Sotah 11b:5">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ונזקקות להן בין ש׳</he> and they had intercourse with them between the mounds in the field; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:12">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 574:1">Yalk. Zech. 574</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 68:14">Ps. LXVIII, 14</cite>) <he>תשכבון בין ש׳ יהודה ועבר הירדן</he> you shall lie (in peace) between the borders: Judah and the shore of the Jordan.
